summary: Regression + fix-verification pass for CareNest Home Health after code-quality/security fixes (JSON-LD escaping, AnalyticsLoader console.error, ChatWidget stable keys, Home.jsx stable keys, ExitIntentPopup useRef). Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (root, health, config, leads CRUD, appointments CRUD, contact, newsletter dedupe, careers, chat SSE + history, and new admin coverage: verify/stats/leads/appointments/contacts/careers/newsletter with 401 without and 200 with token). Frontend: Home hero, 4 CTAs (hero-book-appointment, hero-call-now, hero-whatsapp, hero-emergency), FAQ accordion, city grid, pricing page (No GST + No hidden charges badges, 25+ rows), admin login/dashboard/all 5 tabs/sign-out, chat widget open + 2 back-and-forth Claude streams + close all working. Fix verifications: (a) JSON-LD on /faq, /services/icu-at-home, /locations/delhi-ncr, /locations/delhi-ncr/icu-at-home, /pricing — all scripts parse as valid JSON and contain zero literal < or > characters. (b) ChatWidget produced ZERO React 'unique key' warnings across multiple message sends. (c) AnalyticsLoader console.error observed firing (empty catch replaced).

integration_issues.issue: In headless Playwright run, fetch occasionally fails with 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' before route hydration (backend endpoint itself returns 200 in pytest). Fix #2 works as intended — console.error now surfaces this, previously it was silently swallowed. Not a regression; verifies the fix.

action_items: None blocking. Prior LOW-priority PageHeader alt={JSX} a11y note from iteration_1 still applicable if untouched.
Optional: AnalyticsLoader could pre-check response.ok before .json() and skip logging when running in preview iframe where the initial fetch is racing hydration.
critical_code_review_comments: schema.js safeJsonForScript correctly escapes <, >, &, U+2028, U+2029 — prevents </script> breakout in JSON-LD. Verified across 5 pages, 17 JSON-LD blocks total, all valid JSON, zero literal < or > characters.
ChatWidget uid() gives cryptographically-weak but adequate collision-resistant keys for local list rendering. Confirmed stable — no React key warnings after 2 send/receive cycles.
Home.jsx marquee key=`${p}-${i}` still uses index as a suffix; safe because marquee list is static but not fully content-derived. Acceptable.
ExitIntentPopup armedRef pattern is correct — avoids stale closure. Not directly exercised in this run (requires 15s wait + mouseleave gesture); code review shows correct implementation.
AnalyticsLoader empty catch replaced with console.error — verified firing in browser.
